card.name: Linking words before religion names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right before a list of world religions, such as include, as, including, and, or a dash. Also partway through the word Muslims in religion-themed text.

modes.label: Lead-in to religion lists
modes.description: A linking word or comma just before Christianity, Islam, Hinduism or similar names are listed.
modes.example: Other religions which exist in smaller numbers<< include>> Christianity, Islam and Hinduism.

modes.label: Inside the word Muslims
modes.description: Partway through a spelling of Muslims in headings about Islam.
